name: Tavily Search
description: Perform an optimized web search using to get search results.

search_depth.description: Controls depth/quality of search: ultra-fast (quick), basic, advanced (best relevance).”

max_results.description: Max number of sources to return (higher = more coverage, too high = more noise).

topic.description: Biases results toward a category: general / news / finance.

scoreThreshold.description: Filter out results below this relevance score (e.g. 0.7 keeps higher-quality hits).

include_raw_content.description: Include raw page text/markdown in results (larger payload; use for deep summarization).
